g.text: Data: Caswell et al. 10 MHz · Roger et al. 22 MHz · Guzmán et al. southern 45 MHz

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4c5c63

g.text: These surveys calibrate the smooth diffuse correction; profiles are conditional checks, not independent validation.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4c5c63

g.text: Common 12° smoothing and source masks; 22 MHz scale shares Haslam lineage. Profiles show medians, not error bars.
